title: Header A: consolidated menu
reason: The menu still consumes title width and makes Share a two-step action.

title: Header B: actions beside stats
reason: Gives the title full width while Share remains immediate and other actions stay in a familiar menu.

title: Header C: avatar action sheet
reason: An avatar-attached button suggests an avatar action; the sheet adds a modal step.

title: Achievements A: prioritized tracks
reason: Shows the current goal in each category without a full catalog. Refined with an explicit All tiers entry.

title: Achievements B: category picker
reason: Opening a category into every tier recreates a long, card-heavy catalog.

title: Achievements C: status filters
reason: The icon-only statuses are less self-explanatory and separate goals from their category context.
